info.title: Skryvo API
info.summary: Write, design and publish posts and articles for a person's brands.
info.description:
Skryvo writes, designs and publishes posts and articles for a person's brands. This API
gives a script, an automation or an AI agent the same account the person uses in the app: their
brands, connected channels, plan limits and calendar.

**Authentication.** Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every call. The token is either a
personal API key (`sk_skryvo_…`, made in Settings › API & agents, shown once) or an OAuth access
token (`sko_…`) from the sign-in flow described under `oauth`. A key acts in the workspace it was
made in.

**Times** are ISO 8601. A time without an offset is read in the calendar's own time zone, and every
post moves to the calendar's next quarter hour.

**Spending.** Calls that write or design spend the person's monthly generations or picture credits.
A call that would guess the platforms, pictures or another choice the person did not make returns
`status: confirm` with each setting, where it came from, the cost and what is left, and writes
nothing; call again with `confirmed: true` once the person agrees. A cost the balance cannot cover
is refused before anything is spent.

**Errors.** A refusal is HTTP 422 with `{"detail": "<a sentence to show the person>"}`; a request
that fails validation is 422 with `details` per field. 401 means the key or token no longer works,
403 that the person's team role does not allow the call, 429 that the key sent more than 60
requests a minute or 1000 an hour (see `Retry-After`).

**Webhooks.** Instead of polling, register an HTTPS endpoint under Webhooks and Skryvo POSTs each
event to it, signed with the endpoint's secret.
